expectRed: blocks implementation-critic when the plan path contains ".." that collapses to an existing file with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables planPathValid's explicit '..' check only. The pre-existing '..' test still blocks via the exists-on-disk check after path.join collapses its traversal to a nonexistent path, so only the fixture whose collapsed path exists goes red.

expectRed: blocks implementation-critic when the plan file does not exist on disk with exit 2
mutations.note: Disables planPathValid's exists-on-disk check only — a well-formed plan path with no '..' is accepted even when the file is missing.
